english.note: Choose this for strong respect, especially for someone’s ability, achievement, or character.
Use this when marvelling mainly expresses admiration or respect for someone or something.
Use this for the admiration side of “wonder at,” especially when impressed by someone's ability or achievement.

examples.english: I really admire you for making time to help people even when you are so busy
examples.traditional: 你咁忙都抽時間幫人 我真係佩服你
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam3 mong4 dou1 cau1 si4 gaan3 bong1 jan4 ngo5 zan1 hai6 pui3 fuk6 nei5

examples.english: I really marvel at him for completing the whole race in such heavy rain.
examples.traditional: 我真係佩服佢，咁大風雨都仲堅持跑完全程。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 pui3 fuk6 keoi5 gam3 daai6 fung1 jyu5 dou1 zung6 gin1 ci4 paau2 jyun4 cyun4 cing4

examples.english: I really wonder at how quickly you finished the report.
examples.traditional: 我真係佩服你咁快完成份報告。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 pui3 fuk6 nei5 gam3 faai3 jyun4 sing4 fan6 bou3 gou3
